text:
yara_sales: Heads up 1: EU bank prospect has a 7-year retention + legal-hold requirement for customer-managed keys. Asks: (A) can Redwood store wrapped backups in an EU-only location; (B) can we provide a tamper-proof attestation (notarized timestamp) proving retention; (C) SLA for unwraps during court orders / legal holds; (D) price uplift for region+attestation. Any red flags?

henry_sre: Short: we will not hold plaintext. We can store wrapped ciphertext blobs regionally (EU data residency) on Dedicated or Private. Hosted may be possible but needs region selection and data flow review. :white_check_mark:

azeem_eng: Tech ideas: we can implement region-scoped object buckets with HSM-envelope encryption + immutable object locking. For attestation, we can append RFC3161 timestamps or anchor blob hashes into a public ledger once per week for tamper-evidence. Example stored blob reference: `aws-kms-ciphertext:CiDq...AB2==` (we keep it opaque).

lucy_legal: Legal: Redwood can attest we stored an object at a time (audit logs + timestamping). Notarized certificates are legal services; we can integrate with a notary partner or recommend an escrow notary. Also need to evaluate cross-border transfer risk (Schrems II) if any metadata leaves EU. We should refuse plaintext escrow unless large-enterprise SOW with strict controls.

yara_sales: Customer insists on Redwood being the holder and wants a signed "retention attestation" they can present to regulators. Can we offer a template attestation?

paul_product: Product POV: offer a named add-on: "EU Managed Wrapped-Key Archive + Attestation". Pricing components: per-region storage surcharge, weekly attestation job, optional notarization fee, per-retrieval fee, and per-rotation retention increment. In SOW write "custom quote" until compliance signs off.

henry_sre: Ops caveats: retrieval during legal hold needs a multi-approver runbook (customer-signed warrant + retrieval approval). RTO depends on approval workflow; for expedited legal orders define an SLA and an extra fee. Also carve out customer KMS outages for unwraps if we route unwraps to their KMS.

azeem_eng: Integration checklist to ask the customer now: KMS vendor (AWS KMS/CloudHSM, Azure KV, Thales), wrapped blob format (AWS blob / PKCS#7 / CMS), QPS for unwraps, rotation cadence, whether they require all historical rotated keys preserved for 7 years or only key-versions with an associated legal hold flag, and whether they want weekly hash anchoring to a ledger. Also request a sample wrapped blob.

lucy_legal: Contract snippets I'll draft: (1) "Customer retains sole ownership and control of key material"; (2) "Redwood may store wrapped key blobs only and will not possess plaintext"; (3) "Redwood will provide retention attestations as described in Appendix X; notarization is available as a paid service"; (4) "Carveouts for customer KMS outages and legal-process delays."

compliance_bot: reminder: run `/new-compliance-review eu-wrapped-archive <prospect-name> <scope:retention+attestation+jurisdiction>` before including pricing in SOW.

yara_sales: OK I will reply to the customer: we do not store plaintext; we can offer EU-only managed wrapped backup + retention attestation as an enterprise add-on (custom quote, requires compliance review); unwrap SLA best-effort on Hosted, SLA-backed on Dedicated/Private with carveouts; ask for KMS vendor, wrapped-blob sample, QPS, rotation cadence, and whether they need notarization. Scheduling a 30m scoping call for tomorrow 11am CET.

paul_product: Also add acceptance criteria: rotation dry-run, retrieval drill, and attestation verification in staging.

henry_sre: I'll prepare an ops appendix and a sketch of the multi-approver retrieval flow + expected RTO bands.

azeem_eng: I'll draft the technical runbook and a small PoC script to validate wrapped-blob ingestion. Example ingestion command we can ask them to run in their staging:
```
$ curl -X POST https://inbox.redwood.example/keys/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "blob=@sample-aws-kms-blob.bin" \
  -F "metadata[region]=eu-west-1"
```

lucy_legal: I'll circulate the attestation template and a short retrieval authorization form for review.

yara_sales: Thanks. I'll send the reply + meeting invite and paste customer's answers here. :thumbsup:
